content.text: {"headline":"Approve P4: overtime for 25 payments agents 13:15-14:15, delay all breaks 12:45-13:45 by 45 min, and an IVR outage message, for ₹4,320 and a predicted 84.8% service level against the 80% target.","why":"Payments calls are running about 97% over forecast because of incident INC-20261112-1271, where IMPS/NEFT transfers are stuck in 'pending' after the account has been debited. Service level recovered to 95.8% at 12:30 only because 51 agents were on phones against 36 planned. Doing nothing is predicted to give 68.2% for 12:45-14:45, with 7.3% of callers abandoning. P4 is the cheapest plan that follows policy and reaches the target. It is predicted to give 84.8% over the window (payments 89.7%, general 76.5%), cut abandons to 3.6%, and lift the rest of the day to 93.0%.","trade_offs":["P3 also reaches the target at 81.3% but costs more, ₹5,118. It also leans on chat deflection and callbacks, so P4 is both cheaper and better here.","P1 (no cost, 70.4%) and P2 (₹348, 74.5%) save money but both miss the 80% target, leaving abandons at 6.8% and 5.8%.","General is predicted at 76.5% under P4, slightly below P3's 76.9% and P2's 77.8%. This is because general breaks are also delayed and the overtime goes only to payments, so the general queue carries some risk below target.","P4 has no chat deflection or callback, so it depends on the 25 overtime agents actually accepting."],"watch":"Check overtime uptake before 13:15; if well short of 25, consider P3's extra measures. Watch general queue service level and the incident status, as volume stays high until INC-20261112-1271 is fixed and the 14:15-14:45 period has no overtime cover."}
